collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DISABILITY AND HUMAN DIVERSITY (DIV-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Disabled villagers, chronic illness and every kind of body, skin, hair and face: wheelchairs with real wheels, crutches, canes, ear trumpets, signs and lenses made from island materials; good days and hard days; competence, humor and opinions. Sometimes the difference is the story. Often it's just part of the scenery.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks a deaf adult and another adult; in the story (name1) is deaf and has never wanted to hear)

collection.description: A villager brings a deaf friend a strange little hearing device washed up after the storm: let them look, or ask first.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Among the things that washed up after the storm, (friend) has found a strange little object: curved, smooth, made of something like hard plastic, small enough to sit inside an ear. The old fishers say they've seen them before, and that some people believe they help with hearing. (friend) has brought it straight to (subject), who is deaf, very excited.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) turns it over in (subject.his/her) fingers, curious. (subject.He/she) puts it to (subject.his/her) ear for a moment. Nothing. (subject.He/she) shakes it. It makes a high little whistle, which (subject) can't hear but can feel, and then goes dead. (subject.He/she) hands it back. "Interesting. But I don't need to hear. I'm fine as I am." (friend) is a bit deflated. (subject) signs, kindly, "Thank you for thinking of me."

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (friend) asks before handing it over: would (subject) even want to try? (subject) thinks about it. "Curious? Yes. Want? No." (subject.He/she) looks at it for a while, says it's a clever-looking thing, and suggests they put it with the other found objects the scientists are studying. (friend) does. (subject) goes back to fishing, perfectly content with the quiet.
